title: paeonia corallina var. pallasii
intro: Paeonia corallina var. pallasii, commonly known as Pallas's Peony, is a plant species within the Paeonia genus. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Eastern Europe, to alleviate various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of P. corallina var. pallasii include pain relief, wound healing, and immune system modulation. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
